channel.title: The Awesome Ledger — awesome-home-assistant
channel.description: New entries across the GitHub awesome ecosystem, diffed nightly.

item.title: PadSpan HA — via awesome-home-assistant
item.description: Shows which room every phone, watch and tag is in, live, on a 3D floor plan, using the ESPHome Bluetooth proxies you already have (289★).

item.title: HA Desktop Widget — via awesome-home-assistant
item.description: Desktop app and widget for Windows, macOS and Linux to control entities, watch cameras, view sensors and pin tiles to the desktop.

item.title: Sensor Bar Card Plus — via awesome-home-assistant
item.description: Highly configurable sensor bars and gauges with dynamic scales, multiple fill styles, targets, reference markers, and Tile card integration (96★).
